items.stem: Why does the grader recompute the config digest?
choices: A pasted hash may not match the file actually used

items.stem: Two reruns with the same seed and config disagree. What does that signal?
choices: Hidden nondeterminism to fix before comparing
Normal sampling noise to average away

items.stem: Which seed value fails the manifest check?
What happens to a week-ten figure whose manifest does not reproduce?
choices: It is kept if it looks good
It is rerun with a new seed until it matches
It is removed from the shared packet

items.stem: Changing one newline in config_text does what to the SHA-256?
choices: Changes only the last hex digit

items.stem: Why record the command line verbatim?
choices: So nobody guesses which entry point or flags made a figure
